node.statement: Uniform linear absorption: for ||xi||=1 write p=||P|| and q=||R||. The product bound, ||Q||<=K_q*C_grp*epsilon_r, ||B||<=2r, ||G(B)||<=d||B||, and the local DG bounds imply ||E||<=alpha*p+beta*q with alpha<=K_1*epsilon_r and beta<=K_2*r for universal K_1,K_2. Hence p<=1+alpha*p+beta*q and q<=K_g*r*(1+p)+alpha*p+beta*q. If alpha,beta,K_g*r<=1/8, elementary absorption gives p<=2, q<=K_3*(epsilon_r+r), and therefore ||P+xi||<=||E||<=K_4*(epsilon_r+r), with universal K_3,K_4.
